findings.title: apscheduler missing from pyproject.toml dependencies
findings.description: apscheduler was in requirements-render.txt but not in pyproject.toml. Clean install via `pip install -e '.[dev]'` did not install it, causing test_scheduler_enabled_when_active_mode_true to fail.

findings.title: src/backtest/run_backtest.py had 0% test coverage
findings.description: Core backtest engine (BacktestConfig, WalkForwardBacktester, BacktestTrade, BacktestMetrics) had zero test coverage. These are critical for the walk-forward backtest mission.
findings.fix: Created tests/test_backtest_core.py with 14 tests covering config validation, missing columns, fold integrity, no-trade edge case, dataset hash reproducibility.

findings.title: src/backtest/walk_forward.py had 0% test coverage
findings.description: Walk-forward CLI module _brier_log_loss helper and core logic untested.
findings.fix: Added 3 tests in tests/test_backtest_core.py for _brier_log_loss (normal, perfect, random, empty)

findings.title: Illness/player-state pipeline not integrated into production signal path
findings.description: IllnessFeatureBuilder class exists with correct anti-leakage cutoff logic, but: (1) no real data source fetches injury data, (2) production signal generation always passes illness_features=None, (3) Dixon-Coles model receives no player-state features. The illness infrastructure is scaffolding only.
findings.fix_required: Integrate a public injury data source (e.g. apifootball.com free tier) and call filter_by_cutoff() before signal generation.
findings.test: tests/test_no_lookahead.py covers the class in isolation

findings.title: Tennis model not implemented
findings.description: active_sports_resolver returns ['tennis_atp', 'tennis_wta'] when sport='tennis', but no src/models/tennis_elo.py or src/signals/tennis_signal_scan.py exist. CLAUDE.md describes tennis ELO + Markov models but they are not implemented.
findings.fix_required: Either implement tennis_elo.py with surface-specific Elo or remove tennis from active_sports_resolver to avoid silent no-op.
findings.test: No tennis tests exist (test_tennis.py referenced in docs but file does not exist)

findings.title: src/cron/run_settle.py has 0% test coverage
findings.description: Settlement cron entrypoint completely untested. Settlement is critical for paper ledger integrity.
findings.fix_required: Add integration tests that mock the ledger and verify settlement flow.

findings.title: .gitignore has conflicting rules for data/models/*.pkl
findings.description: Line '!data/models/*.pkl' un-ignores pkl files, but later 'data/models/*.pkl' re-ignores them. The last rule wins so pkl files ARE ignored, but the conflict creates confusion.

findings.title: pickle.load used in model_registry.py
findings.description: pickle.load used for model deserialization. Trust boundary is local filesystem only (data/models/). No untrusted paths are loaded. Models are written by the same codebase via the registry.
findings.verdict: ACCEPTABLE - local filesystem trust boundary is documented

findings.title: subprocess.run in run_signal_pipeline.py
findings.description: subprocess.run used to invoke sub-commands. cmd is always [sys.executable, '-m', ...] + programmatically-built args from argparse.Namespace. No user-controlled string interpolation. shell=False.

findings.title: Closing odds not used as signal input
findings.description: closing_odds_prefix columns are extracted only into signal.clv_reference_odds (CLV post-factum), never into entry_odds or model probability input. Comment at line 512 explicitly documents this.
